_meta.title: CO2e Emission Factors for Passenger Transport
_meta.primary_source: UK Government Greenhouse Gas Conversion Factors 2024 (DEFRA / DESNZ)
notes: All values are kg CO2e (carbon dioxide equivalent) per passenger-kilometre.
CO2e includes CO2, CH4, and N2O weighted by global warming potential (GWP100).
DEFRA values are UK-specific. They are widely used internationally as a reference baseline.
Electric modes (train, metro, tram, e-bike) scale with national grid CO2 intensity.
For electric modes: factor = grid_gCO2e_per_kWh * energy_kWh_per_km / 1000
The factor_kg_per_km for electric modes uses the EU average grid (242 gCO2/kWh, EEA 2023).
IMPORTANT: Always apply electric_mode_formula with the local country grid — never use UK DEFRA rail factors directly for non-UK electric rail.
Example: Vienna U-Bahn or ÖBB REX with AT grid (130 gCO2/kWh): 130 * 0.065 / 1000 = 0.00845 kg/km.
ÖBB (Austrian Federal Railways) runs on ~100% renewable electricity (hydro). The AT grid value of 130 gCO2/kWh is already conservative for ÖBB traction.

car_petrol_average.label: Petrol car (average size)
car_petrol_average.notes: Average-sized petrol car, real-world UK data. Widely used as the car baseline.

car_electric_average.label: Electric car (average size, UK grid)
car_electric_average.notes: UK grid intensity ~238 gCO2/kWh. Adjust for other countries using electric_mode_formula with energy_kwh_per_km ~0.2 for an average EV.

bus_local_average.label: Local city bus (average occupancy)
bus_local_average.notes: 2024 figure. Increased 6.18% from 2023 due to post-COVID ridership recovery reducing per-passenger efficiency.

bus_local_legacy.label: Local city bus (older DEFRA figure, widely cited)
bus_local_legacy.notes: Older value still widely referenced. Higher because it used lower average occupancy assumptions.

train_national_rail_uk.label: Train — National Rail (UK)
train_national_rail_uk.notes: UK-specific. Reflects UK grid mix (~238 gCO2/kWh) and UK national rail average energy use. DO NOT use this factor for non-UK rail — use electric_mode_formula with the correct country grid and the appropriate energy_kwh_per_km instead.

train_regional_electric.label: Regional rail — electric (e.g. REX, S-Bahn, RER)
train_regional_electric.source: Derived: DEFRA 2024 methodology + Ember 2023 EU avg grid (242 gCO2/kWh)
train_regional_electric.notes: Regional electric trains have similar per-passenger energy use to metro/tram (~0.065 kWh/km at average load). Factor = 242 * 0.065 / 1000 = 0.01573 using EU avg grid. Country-specific examples: AT (130 gCO2/kWh) → 0.00845 kg/km; DE (371) → 0.02412 kg/km; FR (58) → 0.00377 kg/km. Always prefer local grid via electric_mode_formula.

train_intercity_electric.label: Intercity rail — electric (e.g. IC, Railjet, ICE)
train_intercity_electric.source: Derived: DEFRA 2024 methodology + Ember 2023 EU avg grid (242 gCO2/kWh)
train_intercity_electric.notes: Long-distance intercity trains are more efficient per passenger-km due to higher load factors and aerodynamic rolling stock. energy_kwh_per_km ~0.035 (same basis as UK national rail). Factor = 242 * 0.035 / 1000 = 0.00847 using EU avg. AT example: 130 * 0.035 / 1000 = 0.00455 kg/km.

train_international.label: Train — international (e.g. Eurostar)
train_international.notes: Eurostar London–Paris example. Very low due to French nuclear + UK grid mix.

tram_light_rail.label: Tram / light rail / Straßenbahn
tram_light_rail.source: DEFRA 2024 methodology (Table 26) + Ember 2023 EU avg grid (242 gCO2/kWh)
tram_light_rail.notes: DEFRA 2024 methodology Table 26 covers tram/light rail GHG factors. Factor = 242 * 0.065 / 1000. Scales with local grid. AT example (130 gCO2/kWh): 0.00845 kg/km.

metro_subway.label: Metro / U-Bahn / subway
metro_subway.source: Derived: DEFRA 2024 methodology + Ember 2023 EU avg grid (242 gCO2/kWh)
metro_subway.notes: Same energy profile as tram. Factor = 242 * 0.065 / 1000 = 0.01573. Country examples: Vienna U-Bahn (AT, 130 gCO2/kWh) → 0.00845 kg/km; Warsaw Metro (PL, 662) → 0.04303 kg/km.

ebike.label: Electric bicycle / e-bike
ebike.source: Derived: DEFRA 2024 methodology + Ember 2023 EU avg grid (242 gCO2/kWh)
ebike.notes: ~0.005 kWh/km. Factor = 242 * 0.005 / 1000 = 0.00121. Near-negligible even on coal-heavy grids.

ferry_foot_passenger.label: Ferry (foot passenger)
ferry_foot_passenger.notes: RoPax ferry foot passenger. Vessel emissions shared across all passengers and freight.

ferry_car_driver.label: Ferry (car driver)
ferry_car_driver.notes: Driver bringing a car onto a ferry. Each additional passenger adds 0.0187 kg/km.

bicycle.label: Bicycle (human-powered)
bicycle.notes: Zero operational emissions. Lifecycle manufacturing ~5 gCO2/km excluded per standard practice.

electric_mode_formula.description: For electric modes, compute country-specific factor as: factor_kg_per_km = grid_gCO2e_per_kWh * energy_kWh_per_km / 1000. Always use this with the local country grid from grid_intensity_by_country — never apply UK DEFRA rail factors directly to non-UK electric rail.
electric_mode_formula.source: IPCC / IEA transport energy use data, cross-referenced with DEFRA 2024 methodology paper

AT.name: Austria
AT.notes: ~70% hydro + wind. ÖBB traction is ~100% renewable — 130 is conservative for ÖBB rail.
